program.name: Two-Block 20
program.subject: Busy week
program.blurb: Strength supersets, then a short conditioning finisher, in about twenty minutes.
program.about: Two blocks in twenty minutes: strength supersets first, then a short conditioning finisher. The supersets pair a push with a pull or a squat with a hinge, and the finisher is a quick AMRAP. Abs close it. Level II moves you one weight up and Level III adds reps. Strength and sweat when time is short.
